Satellite GOMX-3 (GOMX 3)
Spacecraft type CubeSat

Launched 2015-08-19
NORAD ID 40949
Deployer NRCSD (NanoRacks CubeSat Deployer) [Quad-M]
Launcher H-IIB (H2B)
Deployment Deployed from ISS on 2015-10-05
Organisation GomSpace
Institution Company
Entity Commercial
Headquarters Denmark
Manufacturer AIVT by GomSpace
Operator GomSpace
Launch brokerer Nanoracks
Partners ESA (European Space Agency), Danish Ministry of Science and Education, House of Natural Sciences
Oneliner

Demonstrate attitude control, high-speed downlink SDR and ADS-B.
Description

Agile 3-axis attitude control with 1 degree pointing accuracy.

3 Mbps downlink with Syrlinks SATCOM spot-beam characterization using the Software Defined Radio payload. Acquisition of aircraft signals by reception of the ADS-B transponder signal. Part of the outreach programme for the visit of the Danish astronaut Andreas Mogensen to the ISS.
